title: Simply moded mc
description: This modpack adds mostly vanilla like mods from categories all over the place
body:
# Simply moded mc
 This modpack adds mostly vanilla like mods from categories all over the place.
 There are mods for overhauled terrein generation, technology, new weapons, magic and more.\
 This modpack was created for me and my friends to play and i wanted to share it.\
 I hope you enjoy it 

 
##  Here is a list of all the mods included


<details>
<summary>Terrain generation</summary>

  Continents - the overworld now generates continents seperated huge oceans
  -by https://modrinth.com/organization/xdGr4sFb

Terralith - bunch of new biombs created using vannila blocks

Dynamic trees - realistic, dynamically growing trees

Dungeons and taverns - handcrafted dungeons and atmospheric taverns 

Incendium - overhauled nether  

Nullscape - overhauled end  

Yungs colection of mods - reworks vannilla structures and ands new ones 
</details> 


<details>
<summary>Equipment</summary>

Antique Atlas 4 - craftable atlas that functions like an infinite map

Artifacts - various treasure items that can be found through exploration

Comforts - sleeping bags and hammocks

Fishermen's Trap - fish trap to passively collect fish

Charm of Undying - accessory support for the Totem of Undying

Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - A magic mod bringing back the classic RPG spellcasting fantasy

Simply Swords - Spears, Glaives, Chakrams, Katanas, Greathammer/axes, Rapiers, and many more

Minecraft Dungeons Artifacts & More - new artifact mob drops and loads of other stuff!

Minecraft Dungeons Weaponry - weapons from minecraft dungeons to regular minecraft!

Mob Lassos - craftable lassos used to carry mobs in your inventory

Traveler's Backpack - upgradeable backpacks with customisation

TorchMaster - mob spawning control

Chalk - chalk with wich you can draw simbols on blocks

</details>


<details>
<summary>Mobs</summary>

Creeper Overhaul - replaces the vanilla creeper with a variety of different biome-specific creeper types

Fish of Thieves - all the fish from Sea of Thieves

Friends&Foes - outvoted and forgotten mobs from the mob vote

</details>


<details>
<summary>Technology</summary>
Create - Aesthetic Technology that empowers the Player

<details>
<summary>Create addons</summary>
Create Contraption Terminals - Allows Tom's Simple Storage Terminals to work on Create contraptions

Create Slice & Dice - Making automation for Farmers Delight more sensible

Create: Copycats+ - All the copycats you've ever wanted

Create: New Age - integration with electricity.

</details>
Tom's Simple Storage Mod - Simple vanilla style storage mod

</details>


<details>
<summary>Game mechanics</summary>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



</details>

Better Combat - Easy, spectacular and fun melee combat system from Minecraft Dungeons.

Fishing Real - Fish up real entities instead of the items

Farm 3x3 - Harvest 3x3 areas of crops when holding a hoe

FFNutrition - lightweight food nutrition system

Horseman - Improved horses: faster hitching, smooth riding, QOL features and more

MCA Reborn - greatly extends the functionality of villagers

Potion+ - Introduces several new potions to the game

Super Potions - Allows players to use both glowstone and redstone on their potions to make super potions

Tough As Nails - A difficult, survival-based mod that adds body temperature and thirst

Scholar - Two-page book editing/viewing, easy formatting, colored books and more

</details>




<details>
<summary>Miscellaneous</summary>

Exposure - Camera mod with focus on process and aesthetics

Just Enough Items (JEI) - View Items and Recipes

Jade - Shows information about what you are looking at

Item Highlighter - Highlights newly picked-up items

Loot Journal - Smoothly animated item pick-up notifications

Chunky - Pre-generates chunks

Small Ships - Vanilla friendly Ships for Minecraft

Farmer's Delight - A cozy expansion to farming and cooking

<details>
<summary>Farmer's Delight addnos</summary>

Display Delight - Allows to place every food item in Farmer's Delight in 3D

Ender's Delight - An addon for Farmer's Delight based around adding culinary content to the end

Expanded Delight - An addon mod for Farmer's Delight that adds many more crops and functionality 

Miner's Delight - Farmer's Delight add-on for miners

My Nether's Delight - New Nether addon for Farmer's Delight

Storage Delight - Extra furniture for Farmer's Delight that makes your kitchen or any space look better

</details>

</details>



<details>
<summary>Visual</summary>
Beautiful Enchanted Books - Forget about the boring aspects of enchanted books

Beautiful Potions - This mod transforms the visual experience of potions, enhancing every detail

Healight - Adds a green glow when entities heal for clearer feedback
 
Iris Shaders - A modern shader pack loader for Minecraft

Complementary Shaders - Reimagined - Preserving the elements of Minecraft with exceptional quality, detail, and performance.

Traveler's Titles - Epic, RPG-like titles when entering biomes & dimensions!

</details>

Please note that this list does not include libraries, compabilty mods and performance mods. 

If you have any issues or suggestions contact me at matej.kopecky100@gmail.com
